review_notes: Independently read full published-helper decision. The consequential R7/H1/H2 recommendation, scoped corrections, retained origin and rollback chronology meet all five criteria. Numerical experiment timing is proposed, not a source-established duration.
non_material_accuracy_notes: The output asserts that the linked2026 correction fixes the year of the original H1 August dates. The original action/observation omit a year; the link supports an inference but does not supply an explicit original event year.

It proposes at least one exposure week plus about two refund weeks from the different R7 cohort. That is a proposed planning assumption, not evidence that H2 revenue would mature on that schedule; the output also requires a pre-registered window and mature refunds.
